jobs.description: AWS Elastic Beanstalk is looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer (SDE3) to help build and extend the service. Elastic Beanstalk is how developers get an application running on AWS without becoming infrastructure experts — you upload your code, and we handle capacity provisioning, load balancing, auto scaling, and application health monitoring. Our team builds the orchestration system at the center of the service: the public API, the workflow system that provisions and mutates customer environments, the health monitoring subsystem, the eventing pipeline, and the AWS Console experience. We are also in the middle of the most significant architectural expansion in the service's history — extending Elastic Beanstalk to run on Kubernetes and EKS, while continuing to support the millions of environments already running on our classic architecture. Doing both at once, without customer disruption, is a genuinely hard distributed systems problem. If you are someone who is passionate about building high quality services, delighting developers, and reducing the distance between "I have code" and "it's running in production," this job is for you. You will be joining a small team where an SDE3 has real design ownership from day one — you will lead design and implementation efforts on services used at AWS scale, and act as a force multiplier for the engineers around you. To learn more about AWS Elastic Beanstalk, visit https://aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/. Scalability and Resilience: Work on ensuring that the service runs and scales reliably and efficiently. Build an exciting, rewarding career with us – help us make a difference for millions of people every day. Consider joining the Duke Energy team, where you'll find a friendly work environment, opportunities for growth and development, recognition for your work, and competitive pay and benefits. Position Summary Join a team at the heart of grid reliability and customer impact, where your decisions help restore power and keep communities running. The Distribution Control Center (DCC) is the hub that monitors and controls the electric distribution system, coordinates switching and restoration activities, as well as completes device commissioning and modeling to safely and reliably serve customers. In this critical, fast-paced role, you will play a key part in restoring power and supporting grid reliability by monitoring, analyzing, and managing outage events across Duke Energy’s distribution system. You will evaluate outage data, coordinate and direct field resources, and ensure accurate, real-time information is captured to support efficient restoration efforts at the feeder level and below. Working closely with the technical Grid Management team, Senior DCC Operators, and DCC Operations leadership, you will also assist in substation restoration as needed. You will be responsible for modeling work within OMS, DMS, and/or SCADA systems, and controlling the Distribution grid. A critical responsibility as the grid Control Authority includes the issuance of safety and operational tags such as HLTs, Clearance, Do Not Operate, and Information Tags. All switching and tagging activities under the distribution control authority will be fully managed by this role, to ensure safe and efficient response to planned and emergent work impacting the distribution grid. Successful candidates will thrive in high-pressure environments and are energized by problem-solving during critical events. You will play a vital role during abnormal conditions and large-scale outages, providing essential support and contributing to emergency and storm response operations. This role serves as vital support during abnormal or emergency events, requiring sound judgment and the ability to perform under pressure. This opportunity offers exposure to complex grid operations in a 24/7 environment, with rotational shifts and on-call responsibilities that directly support service reliability when it matters most. To be considered for this role, candidates must successfully pass the System Operator/Power Dispatching (SOPD) II test. Once selected for this role, all Operator I positions must successfully pass the Operator Training Certification program and progress to Operator II. The Operator Training Certification program typically takes eighteen to twenty-four months and consists of classroom instruction, on-the-job (OJT) training, and simulator training and assessments. Responsibilities Direct outage dispatching for feeder level outages and below and assist with substation outages. Review outage information and dispatch appropriate field resources to restore power, troubleshoots and analyzes problems to provide possible fault locations and direct restoration efforts. Review, update and ensure correct outage information is modeled in the Outage Management System (OMS) and Distribution Management System (DMS). Also, ensure that the Distribution System model is kept accurate in OMS and DMS to ensure the best optimization. Authorize, record and model in the OMS and DMS: Hot Line Tags (HLT), Clearance tags, Do Not Operate (DNO) tags, and Information tags. Under supervision and direction of Supervisor, Sr DCC Operator, or designee directs and models switching activities in order to maintain an accurate distribution model of the system for the best optimization for megawatts (MWs) from DMS. Periodically review tags in the system to ensure tags are removed promptly and that the system model and data are accurate. Monitor SCADA and DMS systems including remotely opening and closing Feeder Circuit Breakers, Reclosers, and Regulators under normal and emergency situations. Install and remove HLTs remotely. Monitor alarms from SCADA and DMS and assist with determining appropriate response (e.g. low/high voltages, transformer load/temperature alarms, abnormal feeder lockouts, etc.) and provide notification/reports to others. Assist in directing restoration efforts associated with large outages (e.g. feeder lockouts, substation outages, transmission line interruptions, etc.) and ensure that the OMS and DMS models are kept accurate for distribution system optimization to achieve MW reductions if called for on the Distribution System. Assist in developing and calling out emergency switching orders to isolate faults and restore power associated with these large outages. Provide possible fault locations, and if not provided automatically, perform the analysis to determine a predicted fault location. Demonstrated computer and technical aptitude. Job Description The Global Data Office As artificial intelligence and data-driven technologies become increasingly central to Visa’s innovation agenda, the Global Data Office (GDO) is expanding its AI and Data Governance function to ensure responsible, compliant, and effective use of these capabilities across the enterprise. In this role, you will drive Visa’s Responsible Data Use program – evaluating cutting-edge AI and data initiatives – to safeguard trust and unlock business value. You will be at the forefront of Visa’s innovation, guiding how new AI solutions roll out globally while ensuring they meet our obligations to clients, regulators, and consumers. This position offers a unique opportunity to lead cross-functional collaborations, take ownership of mission-critical processes, and shape policies that govern data and AI use at Visa. Key Responsibilities Drive and enhance the Data & AI Use Case Assessment process – a key engine of Visa’s innovation – enabling calculated, transparent risk-taking for faster business growth. You will continuously improve this process to support new AI/data initiatives while maintaining compliance and trust. Execute a wide range of initiatives to implement Visa’s Responsible Data Use framework, including spearheading organizational change management efforts that embed data ethics into the company’s culture. Collaborate across all Visa regions and functions as a catalyst in Visa’s innovation pipeline. Work cross-functionally with teams (Product, Innovation, Analytics, Privacy, etc.) to operationalize data use guidelines globally, ensuring every project meets our standards and obligations. Conduct thorough Data & AI use case reviews: Examine incoming data use requests in detail and evaluate their risk against established Data & AI policies and rules. Where necessary, dive deep into technical specifics (even reverse-engineering algorithms) to ensure compliance and effectiveness. Lead end-to-end analysis of use cases: Take charge of reviews for complex AI and data projects. Identify and document potential risks with precision, bring in additional subject-matter experts for insight when needed, and synthesize all feedback into clear, actionable review reports. Take ownership of expert consultations: Engage internal subject-matter experts (legal, compliance, technology, etc.) to gather feedback on data use scenarios that fall outside existing guidelines. You’ll own these collaborations, ensuring that no critical insight is missed when assessing novel or ambiguous cases. Drive policy improvements: Proactively identify gaps or gray areas in current data use policies. Coordinate with internal stakeholders to propose well-founded policy updates or alternative solutions, backing your recommendations with solid facts and analysis to drive leadership discussions. Provide thought leadership in Data & AI: Develop and share informed perspectives on emerging data and AI domains, including responsible AI, generative AI, data governance, privacy-enhancing technologies, and evolving regulatory expectations. Translate external developments and review insights into practical guidance that shapes policy, strategy, and decision-making across Visa. Champion training and awareness: Help lead workshops and training sessions that educate Visa staff on our Data Use Policy and core data values. Be prepared to step up and lead training sessions, inspiring teams across the organization to uphold responsible data practices. Mentor and develop junior colleagues: Provide day-to-day coaching, constructive feedback, and practical guidance to junior team members. Support their development of sound judgement, technical and policy expertise, and confidence in leading complex Data & AI use case reviews and stakeholder engagements. Amplify our Data & AI Policy & Governance message: Create and curate engaging content for the Global Data Office’s internal sites and our external “Data @ Visa” pages. Your content will showcase progress, highlight success stories, and reinforce the importance of responsible AI and data use. Communicate progress and insights: Prepare compelling materials (presentations, reports, dashboards) to socialize Data & AI Use Policy developments and share insights from Data Use Case Assessment reviews with stakeholders at all levels. Ensure transparency, buy-in, and alignment on data governance initiatives. Take on new challenges: Support ad-hoc Data Policy projects and new initiatives as they arise. Whether it’s a sudden regulatory change or a novel business proposal, you are ready to jump in, adapt, and contribute to solutions in real time. Connect policy and practice: Make sure learnings from Data & AI use case reviews inform the broader data governance strategy. Share insights across teams (“cross-pollination”) so that our policies, guidelines, and operations all advance together in a unified, informed way. Partner with data stakeholders: Work closely with Data Stewards and data requestors to gather complete and detailed information for each use case upfront. By ensuring you have all the facts, you enable more efficient reviews and more effective risk assessments. Position Purpose:
The Health Benefit Representative (HBR) is responsible for educating and assisting individuals with enrolling in affordable health insurance coverage through the NY State of Health Marketplace. This includes Medicaid (NYM), Child Health Plus (CHP), Essential Plan (EP), Qualified Health Plans (QHP), and Health & Recovery Plan (HARP). The HBR engages prospective members who are uninsured or seeking new coverage and supports existing members with renewals and benefit education. All activities are performed in compliance with the Affordable Care Act (ACA), FE Integrity Guidelines, Regulatory Guidelines, and Fidelis Care Standards, with a strong focus on customer experience and community engagement.

Key Details: Community field based travel position covering Bronx County, NY (Bronx, Manhattan, and Queens). Assist members in signing up for coverage via NYSOH and enter data into Salesforce. Bilingual - English/Arabic, Urdu, Hindi, or Spanish.

• Educate and assist individuals with enrolling in coverage through the NY State of Health Marketplace, including Medicaid (NYM), Child Health Plus (CHP), Essential Plan (EP), Qualified Health Plans (QHP), and Health & Recovery Plan (HARP).
• Explain eligibility for public programs, federal premium tax credits, and cost-sharing reductions, including potential impacts to consumers.
• Teach members about Fidelis digital tools (member portal, mobile app)
• Describe plan features, benefits, and cost-sharing mechanisms (deductibles, co-pays, co-insurance) and how these affect consumers.
• Explain metal tiers within the Marketplace and how benefits vary by income level.
• Assist consumers with submitting required documents via scan, fax, or mail.
• Support existing members with renewals and recertifications.
• Help consumers with premium payment submissions when required.
• Provide culturally and linguistically appropriate assistance.
• Conduct public education activities and presentations to raise awareness of Fidelis Care products and Marketplace options.
• Participate in ACA forums, workshops, and community events as requested.
• Maintain a daily tracking tool that entails detailed rep activity.
• Monitor all applications in personal dashboard to ensure timely and accurate follow through from applicants.
• Conduct a daily review of personal dashboard to address and follow-up on any and/or all potential leads for consumers seeking assistance.
• Keep abreast of all the Marketplace functionalities to effectively manage individual accounts.
• Follow-up on all new potential enrollment leads and consumer inquiries. Record all follow-up dispositions in a timely and accurate manner within the required "CRM".
• Data enter all applicant demographic, enrollment site and PCP selection data in the required "CRM" at the time of the initial enrollment encounter.
• Must be in compliance with all conflict-of-interest standards and regulations.
• Required to work evenings and weekends.
• Secure and safeguarding confidential information to prevent Protected Health Information (PHI) from being obtained from unauthorized personnel to ensure compliance with privacy and security standards.
• Provide information in a manner that is culturally and linguistically appropriate to the needs of the population being served by the Marketplace.
• Participate in all trainings, updates and webinars and other forums in which information is necessary to carry out roles and responsibilities.
• Mandated to meet the annual Marketplace Facilitated Enroller (MFE) recertification requirements.
• Keep abreast of all industry and regulatory updates as it pertains to the ACA and Marketplace.
• Maintain discretion regarding business-related files, reports, and conversations within the provisions of applicable State and Federal Statutes and regulations.
• Perform all other tasks and responsibilities as required to satisfy the expectations of the role.
• Performs other duties as assigned.
• Complies with all policies and standards.

Additional Experience/Skills

• Highly Preferred - Bilingual – English/Arabic
• Bilingual - English/Urdu, Hindi, Spanish
• Customer Service
• Healthcare
• Enrollment Counselor/Health Navigator
• Community Outreach
• Sales (Front Facing or Field Sales)
• Public Speaking
• Comfortable with field-based travel requirements supporting Bronx County, NY (Bronx, Manhattan, and Queens)

Work Schedule: Mon. - Fri. with occasional evenings and weekends

Education/Experience:

• Must have a High School Diploma or GED
• 2+ years of prior experience in managed care, sales, customer service or related experience preferred
• Must have basic computer skills

Driver's License: Preferred for NYC counties, Mandatory for non-NYC counties

Certifications: Must complete and pass the NY State of Health approved training program and become certified. Must complete all required annual recertification courses/learnings.

Pay Range: $23.23 - $39.61 per hour

jobs.description: AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset. The AWS Enterprise Support team is growing to meet the demands of a portfolio of always-on latency-sensitive enterprise customers whose production workloads run across global AWS regions. As a Senior Technical Account Manager (TAM) you will be the named technical point of accountability for some of the team's largest accounts - owning architectural guidance, operational strategy, and proactive support delivery end to end. The team is investing in three areas where you will have immediate impact: converting recurring support patterns into reusable automation and documented procedures deepening technical expertise in databases containers networking and capacity planning and shifting the delivery mix from reactive case work to proactive resilience reviews cost planning and measurable customer outcomes. If you want to own a customer relationship where every interaction matters and your contributions raise the bar for the whole team this is the role. Key job responsibilities • Own the end-to-end technical relationship for a portfolio of enterprise customers advising on cloud architecture operational strategy and launch readiness across global AWS regions. • Assess customer environments for architectural risks and scaling constraints then build actionable plans that maintain business continuity for workloads with 24/7 uptime requirements and unpredictable demand patterns. • Collaborate with account teams, Solutions Architects, and AWS service teams for compute, database, container, and networking services to resolve complex issues and drive product improvements informed by real customer patterns. • Analyze operational metrics and deliver periodic performance reviews to customer leadership translating data into clear recommendations that strengthen security posture cost efficiency and system reliability. • Contribute to the team's shared knowledge base standard operating procedures and reusable automation and mentor fellow Technical Account Managers to raise the collective capability of the group. A day in the life You might start the morning reviewing an operational dashboard for a customer whose traffic can spike without warning then jump into a call with their engineering team - in Mandarin - to walk through a scaling plan for an upcoming product release. After lunch you could be partnering with an AWS service team to troubleshoot a networking issue that spans a complex multi-account topology and later in the afternoon you present a quarterly architecture review to a customer's leadership highlighting risks mitigated and opportunities ahead. About the team Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud. Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
